feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: International news, global reporting and analysis from NPR. Plus dispatches from NPR’s State of the World podcast.

entry.title: 'Like gods reigning over humans': Many defectors see daughter of North Korea's Kim as heir apparent
entry.summary: Little is known about her except that she's reportedly about 13 and named Kim Ju Ae, but Korea's spy agency says she's likely her father's heir.

entry.title: Indonesia's VP offers resignation as questions mount over his eligibility
entry.summary: His resignation offer comes amid a widening political rift between Prabowo and Widodo and a separate investigation into allegations that senior police officials wiretapped the president.

entry.title: House set to vote to impeach Hegseth. And, SCOTUS allows border wall work to proceed
entry.summary: The House could vote to impeach Hegseth, but removing him from office will be tough. And, SCOTUS ruled that a federal judge did not have the authority to halt border wall construction.

entry.title: Russia and Ukraine hold nearly 4 hours of U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi
entry.summary: Hopes of progress in ending Europe's biggest conflict since World War II are tempered by the absence of any significant breakthroughs in three previous rounds of talks early this year.

entry.title: Kushner and Witkoff renew peace talks to end war between Russia and Ukraine
entry.summary: President Trump's top envoy is in Abu Dhabi with negotiators from Russia and Ukraine to resume peace talks.

entry.title: France accuses Iran of cyber 'sabotage' in fridge attacks
entry.summary: France says Iranian military hackers took over refrigeration controllers at around 700 different retail sites last month, turning up temperatures in the middle of the night and spoiling millions of dollars' worth of food.

entry.title: What Trump meant when he said the U.S. is cutting aid to Israel
entry.summary: President Trump says he's halting aid to Israel. Israelis are worried. But experts say the U.S. is just shifting aid from the State Department to the Pentagon, with less congressional oversight.

entry.title: Thick smog shrouds New Delhi after Diwali firecrackers add to seasonal pollution
entry.summary: New Delhi, home to over 30 million people, regularly ranks among the world's most polluted areas during winter, with pollution worsening in late October and November.

entry.title: British comedian Russell Brand sentenced to over 10 years for rape and sexual assault
entry.summary: Russell Brand, who became a celebrity darling in the early 2000s, was found guilty on one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault in a case brought by six women.

entry.title: Congress is back after GOP's midterm defeat. And, Trump appoints new chief of staff
entry.summary: Republicans have just weeks left of control of Congress. Here's what to expect. And, Trump has appointed Stephen Miller as his new chief of staff, signaling his readiness to confront his opposition.
